en.NAME: License Lifecycle
en.DESCRIPTION: Manages the lifecycle of a license from initial entry through verification, active use, expiration, suspension, revocation, or replacement.

en.NAME: Active
en.DESCRIPTION: The license has been verified, is currently valid, and may be used for the activities or qualifications it authorizes.

en.NAME: Mark as Expiring Soon
en.DESCRIPTION: Marks the license as approaching its expiration date while it remains valid. This transition is typically triggered automatically based on the expiration date.

en.NAME: Expire License
en.DESCRIPTION: Marks the license as expired because its expiration date has passed. This transition is typically triggered automatically.

en.NAME: Suspend License
en.DESCRIPTION: Temporarily invalidates the license due to an administrative or regulatory restriction.

en.NAME: Revoke License
en.DESCRIPTION: Permanently invalidates the license following revocation by the issuing authority.

en.NAME: Replace License
en.DESCRIPTION: Marks the license as superseded by a newer license record while preserving the original for historical reference.

en.NAME: Draft
en.DESCRIPTION: License information has been created but is incomplete or has not yet been submitted for verification.

en.NAME: Submit for Verification
en.DESCRIPTION: Submits the entered license information and supporting document for verification.

en.NAME: Replace License
en.DESCRIPTION: Marks the license as superseded by a newer license record while preserving the original for historical reference.

en.NAME: Expired
en.DESCRIPTION: The license has passed its expiration date and can no longer be used as valid authorization.

en.NAME: Replace License
en.DESCRIPTION: Marks the license as superseded by a newer license record while preserving the original for historical reference.

en.NAME: Expiring Soon
en.DESCRIPTION: The license remains valid but is approaching its expiration date and requires renewal or replacement.

en.NAME: Expire License
en.DESCRIPTION: Marks the license as expired because its expiration date has passed. This transition is typically triggered automatically.

en.NAME: Suspend License
en.DESCRIPTION: Temporarily invalidates the license due to an administrative or regulatory restriction.

en.NAME: Revoke License
en.DESCRIPTION: Permanently invalidates the license following revocation by the issuing authority.

en.NAME: Replace License
en.DESCRIPTION: Marks the license as superseded by a newer license record while preserving the original for historical reference.

en.NAME: Pending Verification
en.DESCRIPTION: The license has been submitted and is awaiting verification of its details, supporting document, and current validity.

en.NAME: Verify License
en.DESCRIPTION: Confirms that the license details are accurate and that the license is currently valid.

en.NAME: Replaced
en.DESCRIPTION: The license record has been superseded by a newer license document and is retained only for historical reference.

en.NAME: Revoked
en.DESCRIPTION: The license has been permanently revoked by the issuing authority and can no longer be used or reinstated.

en.NAME: Suspended
en.DESCRIPTION: The license has been temporarily suspended and cannot be used until it is reinstated or replaced.

en.NAME: Expire License
en.DESCRIPTION: Marks the license as expired because its expiration date has passed. This transition is typically triggered automatically.

en.NAME: Reinstate License
en.DESCRIPTION: Restores a suspended license after the suspension has been lifted.

en.NAME: Revoke License
en.DESCRIPTION: Permanently invalidates the license following revocation by the issuing authority.

en.NAME: Replace License
en.DESCRIPTION: Marks the license as superseded by a newer license record while preserving the original for historical reference.
